description: This file defines a custom subclass of SwipeRefreshLayout called MultiSwipeRefreshLayout, which supports multiple child views that can trigger a swipe-to-refresh gesture. It manages a set of swipeable child views and overrides canChildScrollUp to determine if any of these views can scroll up, controlling when the refresh gesture can be initiated.

classes.name: MultiSwipeRefreshLayout
classes.description: A custom layout extending SwipeRefreshLayout to support multiple swipeable child views, enabling multiple triggers for refresh gestures.

methods.name: setSwipeableChildren
methods.description: Sets which child views can trigger a refresh gesture, identified by their resource IDs.

methods.name: canChildScrollUp
methods.description: Determines whether any of the swipeable children can scroll up; if not, allows the swipe-to-refresh gesture to occur.

methods.name: canViewScrollUp
methods.description: Checks if an individual view can scroll up, compatible across different Android API levels.
